strings.zh: 这个战斗舞台里{NEWLINE}用３０级以上的精灵进行战斗{CLEAR}看能撑到什么程度。{CLEAR}我们有精灵种类{NEWLINE}以及连胜场次的记录。{CLEAR}不论哪一只精灵都可以{NEWLINE}向着最强的目标去挑战！{SCROLL}如果要开始进行战斗{NEWLINE}首先请选择精灵的{CLEAR}种类和级别。{SCROLL}和符合条件的精灵进行战斗。{SCROLL}成功实现１０连胜的话{NEWLINE}就能获赠ＢＰ点！{SCROLL}另外,如果想临时中止挑战。{SCROLL}请保存好进度,{NEWLINE}不然就不能接着{SCROLL}这个中断点继续玩了！{NEWLINE}请一定要注意！{SCROLL}
strings.en: At the Battle Hall, you battle{NEWLINE}with Pokémon of Lv. 30 or higher{CLEAR}to see how far you can go.{SCROLL}We keep records for each kind{NEWLINE}of Pokémon and its winning{CLEAR}streak, so any Pokémon at all{CLEAR}can aim to be the strongest!{SCROLL}To start, first choose the type and{NEWLINE}rank of the Pokémon you want to face.{SCROLL}Then you battle Pokémon{NEWLINE}that match your choice.{SCROLL}Win 10 matches in a row,{NEWLINE}and you’ll receive BP!{SCROLL}Also, if you want to{NEWLINE}pause your challenge,{SCROLL}please save your progress.{NEWLINE}Otherwise, you won’t be able to{CLEAR}continue from where you stopped.{CLEAR}Please keep that in mind!{SCROLL}

strings.en: You may team up with a friend for a Multi{NEWLINE}Battle challenge using the same kind of{CLEAR}Pokémon that are at least Lv. 30 each.{SCROLL}When you start, you will first be asked{NEWLINE}to choose the type and rank of the{CLEAR}Pokémon, and then you battle Pokémon{CLEAR}that match your choice.{SCROLL}Keep battling, and if you manage to win{NEWLINE}ten matches in a row, you will earn{CLEAR}Battle Points (BP)!{SCROLL}Please note: a Battle Hall Multi Battle{NEWLINE}challenge can’t be interrupted.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 吃饭的时候,你是先吃喜欢的,{NEWLINE}还是把它留在最后呢？{SCROLL}我有个建议,{NEWLINE}在这座战斗舞台,{CLEAR}你应该先选择自己不擅长的类型！{SCROLL}因为战斗越到后面,{NEWLINE}对手的等级也越高！

strings.zh: 我真是爱死这地方了！{SCROLL}这里会根据精灵的不同种类,{NEWLINE}对其连胜纪录进行保存,{CLEAR}所以无论哪种精灵{CLEAR}都能登上那座舞台！{SCROLL}让自己的精灵{NEWLINE}不断刷新纪录,{CLEAR}这感觉真是妙不可言！

strings.en: At the Battle Hall, if it’s the same kind{NEWLINE}of Pokémon, you can enter different{CLEAR}ones and still keep your record.{SCROLL}You may want to have different ones{NEWLINE}knowing different types of moves.

strings.zh: 以毽子草做比方,{NEWLINE}它是「草」和「飞行」{CLEAR}类型的精灵。{SCROLL}所以它不仅会出现在「草」类型,{NEWLINE}还会出现在「飞行」类型中！{SCROLL}你问我是什么类型？{NEWLINE}讨厌啦,人家是⋯⋯{CLEAR}「爽朗」和「美女」类的啦。
strings.en: You know how Hoppip has two{NEWLINE}types--Grass and Flying?{SCROLL}That means it can appear not just as a{NEWLINE}Grass type, but as a Flying type too!{SCROLL}What type am I, you ask? Oh, stop it!{NEWLINE}I’m... a “Cheerful” type and a{CLEAR}“Beautiful” type.

strings.zh: 我告诉你件事,{SCROLL}战斗舞台中,{NEWLINE}对方精灵的等级{CLEAR}会根据我方{CLEAR}派出的精灵等级而进行改变。{SCROLL}所以我们无需为{NEWLINE}精灵的等级担心,{CLEAR}只管派自己想派的精灵就行了。
strings.en: A piece of advice...{SCROLL}At the Battle Hall, the opposing{NEWLINE}Pokémon are matched in level to yours.{SCROLL}That way, you can choose any of your{NEWLINE}Pokémon without worrying about{CLEAR}their levels.
